name: Clinical Notes Summarizer
problem: Physicians spent excessive time reading lengthy patient notes.
solution: Built a transformer‑based abstractive summarization service deployed on SageMaker with a FastAPI wrapper. Implemented CI/CD pipelines and model versioning via MLflow.

name: Product Recommendation Engine
problem: Low conversion due to irrelevant product suggestions.
solution: Created a Retrieval‑Augmented Generation pipeline that pulls product metadata from PostgreSQL and generates personalized recommendations via LangChain. Deployed as a Dockerized microservice on SageMaker.

name: Real‑Estate Document Analyzer – Phase 1
problem: Agents manually extracted key clauses from lease agreements.
solution: Trained a spaCy NER model to tag dates, rent amounts, and termination clauses, storing results in PostgreSQL for downstream use.
outcome_metrics: Manual extraction time cut from 12 min to 2 min per document

name: Real‑Estate Document Analyzer – Phase 2
problem: Agents needed fast lookup of similar contracts across the portfolio.
solution: Extended Phase 1 with a vector‑search layer using pgvector and LangChain, exposing a semantic search API via FastAPI.

name: Real‑Estate Document Analyzer – Phase 3
problem: No automated monitoring for model drift after deployment.
solution: Implemented an Airflow DAG that logs prediction distributions to MLflow and triggers retraining alerts when drift exceeds 5%.
outcome_metrics: Retraining cycles reduced from quarterly to as needed
Model performance stability > 0.95 F1 over 6 months

name: Automated Grading Assistant
problem: Instructors spent hours manually grading short‑answer responses.
solution: Built a TF‑IDF + XGBoost classifier to score answers against rubric criteria, wrapped in a FastAPI service for batch processing.

name: Legal Contract Review Bot
problem: Lawyers needed quick insights on clause risk across thousands of contracts.
solution: Deployed a RAG system that indexes contract clauses in pgvector and answers risk‑related queries using a fine‑tuned BERT model.

name: Media Content Tagger
problem: Manual tagging of millions of images slowed content publishing.
solution: Trained a ResNet‑50 model on a custom taxonomy, served via SageMaker endpoint, and integrated OpenCV preprocessing pipeline.

name: Fraud Detection Dashboard
problem: Increasing transaction fraud was eroding customer trust.
solution: Developed an XGBoost classifier with feature engineering pipelines, logged experiments in MLflow, and scheduled nightly retraining via Airflow.

name: Volunteer Matchmaking Platform
problem: Non‑profits struggled to find suitable volunteers based on skill descriptions.
solution: Created a semantic matching engine that embeds volunteer profiles and project needs, storing vectors in pgvector and exposing a FastAPI endpoint.

name: Predictive Maintenance for Assembly Lines
problem: Unexpected equipment failures caused costly downtime.
solution: Implemented a LSTM‑based forecasting model for sensor streams, tracked experiments with MLflow, and orchestrated data pipelines via Airflow.

name: Dynamic Pricing Engine
problem: Hotels lacked real‑time price optimization based on demand signals.
solution: Trained a GradientBoostingRegressor on booking data, deployed via SageMaker, and set up MLflow for model monitoring.

name: Route Optimization Service
problem: Delivery routes were planned manually, causing inefficiencies.
solution: Built a VRP solver using NetworkX, exposed as a FastAPI microservice, and containerized for scalable SageMaker deployment.

name: Sentiment‑aware Chatbot for Customer Support
problem: Support agents were overwhelmed by high‑volume, emotionally charged tickets.
solution: Integrated a sentiment‑aware conversational agent that routes angry customers to live agents while handling routine queries automatically.

name: Image Quality Assurance Pipeline
problem: Photographers needed automated detection of blurry or over‑exposed shots.
solution: Created a lightweight OpenCV script that evaluates sharpness and exposure, packaged as a Docker CLI tool for batch processing.
